campaign_name: PR-PLAY — Grounded Marking Removal and Lifecycle Closure
purpose: Player-facing removal of one established visible marking through the existing chat turn and removal service
executive_summary: **A/PASS.** A player can create a visible marking, read it, wipe that one marking off in ordinary language, and read its absence. The removal commits through prepare_removal. Save, reload, and snapshot restore keep it removed. An exact retry does not remove it again. Concealed, restricted, and a second identical marking are not selected. A contradictory seal is replaced by the committed sentence. Twelve-turn text matches the immediate predecessor. Focused modules 611 passed. Combined before and after: 405 passed / 20 failed / 0 errors / 0 skipped (425 tests), same identities. Live provider calls 0. The marking lifecycle can close as a bounded subsystem. Next milestone: pr_play_broad_gameplay_evaluation. Do not begin automatically.

validation: 15 removal tests passed inside a 611-passed focused run.
tooling: Cycle-local twelve-turn comparison and removal timing
generated_artifacts: Controlled lifecycle evidence, regression junit, twelve-turn comparison, and a fresh review archive

testing.focused: Removal 15 passed. Observation 10 passed. Grounded marking 12 passed. Focused command 611 passed / 0 failed.
testing.broader: Combined before and after: 405 passed / 20 failed / 0 errors / 0 skipped (425 tests). New failing identities: none. Newly passing: none.
testing.runtime_validation: Controlled HTTP mark, observe, wipe, observe, reload, retry, and snapshot restore. Twelve-turn HTTP run. Publication and feasibility tests.
testing.pre_existing_failures: The same 20 combined identities before and after. Seventeen match the predecessor. Three classification tests had already failed in this cycle's before run. See REGRESSION_RESULTS.md.

decisions_requiring_human_review: No further authorization required for this bounded implementation.

campaign_specific: Original T06 stays unresolved because no garment or medium is established. A pronoun does not select an object. Required consumption and required mechanics stay unresolved. Ordinary observation does not certify that concealed markings are absent.

missing_concepts: A broader gameplay evaluation of the remaining twelve-turn gaps.
does_not_prove: Environmental material inference, consumption, mechanical skill checks, bulk removal, a full suite, live-model play, or all object interaction.
recommended_next_step: Exactly one recommended next milestone: pr_play_broad_gameplay_evaluation — one provider-free pass over the remaining twelve-turn gaps that names a single later integration target. Do not begin automatically.
self_contained_review_test: Reopen the archive and confirm milestone identity, the controlled HTTP lifecycle, target and marking resolution, physical feasibility, authoritative removal, publication integrity, confidentiality, save/reload and snapshots, regressions, the twelve-turn comparison, subsystem closure, and the updated handoff.
